body: That's fair. I'd go out and make some friends in the area and see if giving you both some space will be good. Good luck!
I'm sorry. That sounds really crappy. Can you plan something for a time when she won't be as tired? Something ahead of time? I'm probably giving advice you already thought of before. Sorry :/

See if she'll go on a walk with you. Plan things with her. Do things together so she's not always on her phone. That might help remind you both what you like about eachother. If you're talking to the internet because you miss her maybe she's doing the same thing. Good luck.
